pageDescription: Complete breakdown of all skills and question task types for IELTS and PTE exams

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: Talk in English with an interviewer using your voice

topics.name: Introduction
topics.simpleDescription: Answer basic personal questions about yourself, your hobbies, and hometown

topics.name: Speaking Part 2 (Cue Card)
topics.simpleDescription: Speak for 1–2 minutes on a given topic after 1 minute of preparation

topics.name: Speaking Part 3 (Discussion)
topics.simpleDescription: Practise explaining and comparing ideas on broader issues related to a topic; the full examiner-led discussion lasts 4–5 minutes

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Write clear essays and describe charts in English

topics.name: Describe the figure
topics.simpleDescription: Explain a chart, graph, map, or diagram in at least 150 words

topics.name: Opinion / Agree or Disagree
topics.simpleDescription: Write a 250-word essay stating your point of view on a topic

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read long stories/articles and answer questions about them

topics.name: Multiple Choice
topics.simpleDescription: Read a text and choose the correct answer — some questions take one, some take several

topics.name: True / False / Not Given
topics.simpleDescription: Decide whether statements agree with the passage, contradict it, or are not mentioned at all

topics.name: Yes / No / Not Given
topics.simpleDescription: Identify if statements agree with, contradict, or are not mentioned in the writer's views

topics.name: Matching Information
topics.simpleDescription: Locate which lettered paragraph contains specific information; this is not matching headings

topics.name: Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Fill in missing words in sentences using words taken directly from the passage

listening.title: Listening
listening.description: Listen to audio recordings and answer questions

topics.name: Fill in the blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Type the missing words you hear in the voice recording

topics.name: Choose the correct answer
topics.simpleDescription: Pick the right multiple choice option from what you hear

topics.name: Navigating according to audio
topics.simpleDescription: Follow directions on a map or plan as the speaker guides you

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: Speak into the computer microphone to test pronunciation, oral fluency, and comprehension

topics.name: Read Aloud
topics.simpleDescription: Read a short paragraph shown on screen out loud naturally and clearly

topics.name: Repeat Sentence
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a sentence and repeat it word for word accurately

topics.name: Describe Image
topics.simpleDescription: Look at a picture, chart, or graph and talk about it in detail for 40 seconds

topics.name: Re-tell Lecture
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a talk or lecture and summarize what you heard in your own words

topics.name: Answer Short Questions
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a simple question and give a direct one or few-word answer

topics.name: Summarise Group Discussion
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to multiple speakers discussing a topic and summarize the conversation

topics.name: Respond to a Situation
topics.simpleDescription: Read and listen to a situation, prepare for 10 seconds, then respond appropriately for up to 40 seconds

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Write summaries and essays assessed on content, grammar, vocabulary, and structure

topics.name: Summarise Written Text
topics.simpleDescription: Read a passage and write a one-sentence summary of 5 to 75 words

topics.name: Write Essay
topics.simpleDescription: Write a 200–300 word argumentative essay on a given topic

topics.name: Repeated Essay Questions
topics.simpleDescription: Practice high-frequency and repeated PTE exam essay prompts with AI feedback

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read paragraphs, choose multiple choices, and solve sentence re-ordering and fill-in-blanks

topics.name: Fill in the Blanks (Dropdown)
topics.simpleDescription: Select the best word from drop-down menus to complete sentences in a reading text

topics.name: Multiple Type Multiple Answer
topics.simpleDescription: Read a passage and select all correct options that answer the question

topics.name: Reorder Paragraph
topics.simpleDescription: Drag and drop shuffled sentences or paragraphs into the correct logical order

topics.name: Reading Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Drag words from a word pool into empty slots inside a reading paragraph

topics.name: Multiple Type Single Answer
topics.simpleDescription: Read a passage and choose the single best answer option

listening.title: Listening
listening.description: Listen to authentic audio recordings and complete comprehension, dictation, and summary tasks

topics.name: Summarize Spoken text
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a short lecture or dialogue and write a 50–70 word summary

topics.name: MCQ Multiple Answer
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a recording and choose all correct options that apply

topics.name: Listening Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Type the missing words into text blanks as you listen to the audio

topics.name: Highlight Correct Summary
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to an audio recording and choose the paragraph that best summarizes it

topics.name: MCQ Single Answer
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a recording and choose the single correct answer option

topics.name: Select Missing Word
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a recording where the final word is replaced with a beep and select the missing word

topics.name: Highlight Incorrect Word
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to the recording while reading a transcript and click the words that differ

topics.name: Write from Dictation
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a sentence and type every word you hear accurately
